item.title: Marketinguys
item.description:
Marketinguys works as a directory of marketing talent. Businesses looking for a freelancer or agency can browse profiles, compare specialties such as SEO, social media, or branding, and reach out to candidates.

Directories like this save time in the first round of research, though quality varies and vetting is the buyer’s job. Check portfolios, references, and contracts before hiring.

Independent information is limited. The platform is free to browse. Alternatives include Clutch, Upwork, Fiverr, DesignRush, and Sortlist. Marketinguys suits businesses looking for marketing help.

item.title: GCS Cheats
item.description:
GCS Cheats sells subscriptions to cheat programs for multiplayer games, delivering license keys after payment. The tools advertised include aimbots, wallhacks that show enemy positions, and similar modifications that give a player an unfair advantage.

Using cheats breaks the rules of almost every online game and publisher, and anti-cheat systems detect and ban accounts, sometimes at the hardware level. Cheating also spoils the experience for other players. Software from cheat sellers can carry malware or steal account data, since it often needs to run with high system privileges, and buyers have little recourse if something goes wrong.
